Bill.BriefDescription: Concerning boarding benefits on a certain ferry route.

BillBody.BillTitle: AN ACT Relating to boarding benefits on a certain ferry route; andadding a new section to chapter 47.60 RCW.
BillBody.EnactingClause: BE IT ENACTED BY THE LEGISLATURE OF THE STATE OF WASHINGTON:

BegSecNew.BegSecText: A new section is added to chapter 47.60 RCWto read as follows:

BillSection.RCWSLText: Until a reservation system is in place at the San Juan inner islandferry route, the department shall provide the same preferentialboarding benefits to home health care workers on the San Juan innerisland ferry route that are provided to patients traveling for medicaltreatment.
